phase_prompt.label: The Oath at the Gate Band
phase_prompt.summary: The moment of decision at the summit of the ingress point. They stand in a circle, binding their code together before descending into the simulation proper.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic eye-level medium shot of five distinct men standing in a tight circle on a dark, rocky precipice. The lighting is low-key, illuminated only by the faint blue bioluminescence of their fiber-optic veined skin and the glowing Geez glyphs hovering in the air between them. They are clasping forearms, their expressions grave and fearful. The texture of their dark, basalt-like robes contrasts with the soft, volumetric fog swirling around their knees. The background is a blur of dark blue sky and distant digital artifacts. Cinematic color grading, high contrast, anamorphic lens flares.
